# vrtstack

Stack 2D rasters along a new dimension, producing GDAL Multidimensional
VRT files.

See a real example in “./example.R” where we generate MDIM VRT in a one
line call, it parses the date from the file URIs. (Write that to
textxml.vrt for later reuse).

## The Problem

You have a directory of COGs or GeoTIFFs representing slices along some
dimension:

    claytotal_0_cm.tif    # depth = 0 cm
    claytotal_5_cm.tif    # depth = 5 cm
    claytotal_15_cm.tif   # depth = 15 cm
    ...

Or a time series:

    temperature_20230101.tif
    temperature_20230102.tif
    temperature_20230103.tif
    ...

You want to treat these as a **single multidimensional array** -
selectable by depth or time - without copying data into a new format.

## The Solution

GDAL’s [Multidimensional VRT
driver](https://gdal.org/drivers/raster/vrt_multidimensional.html) can
virtually assemble 2D rasters into a multidimensional structure. But
creating the VRT XML by hand is tedious.

**vrtstack** generates these VRTs programmatically:

``` r

library(vrtstack)

gdal_mdim_stack(
  files = list.files(pattern = "claytotal_.*\\.tif$"),
  dim_name = "depth",
  dim_values = c(0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 100, 150),
  dim_type = "VERTICAL",
  dim_direction = "DOWN",
  dim_unit = "cm",
  output = "claytotal.vrt"
)
```

The resulting VRT can be read by: - GDAL’s multidim API (`gdalmdiminfo`,
`gdalmdimtranslate`) - Python xarray via
[gdx](https://github.com/mdsumner/gdx) or
[xgdal](https://github.com/scottyhq/xgdal) - Any tool supporting GDAL
multidimensional rasters

## Three ways in

[`gdal_mdim_stack()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/gdal_mdim_stack.md)
above builds a new dimension from 2D rasters. Two more paths cover
sources that are already multidimensional, and sources described by a
catalog:

- **Extend a recipe** (`vrtstack(..., template = TRUE)`): for
  NetCDF/Zarr/HDF5 sources that may carry several arrays at once, take a
  small “first-n” mdim VRT as a recipe and flesh it out to the full file
  set, re-writing only the concat dimension and the per-array source
  lists. `metadata_from` and the
  [`graft_coord_units()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/graft_coord_units.md)
  /
  [`graft_group_attrs()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/graft_group_attrs.md)
  helpers restore coordinate units and provenance that
  `gdal mdim mosaic` drops.
- **Emit from a signature**
  ([`emit_mdim_vrt()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/emit_mdim_vrt.md)):
  when the grid is known from a catalog, build the VRT from a sources
  table
  ([`mdim_sources()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/mdim_sources.md))
  and a grid signature
  ([`mdim_signature()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/mdim_signature.md))
  without opening a file - “identical grid or refuse”.
  [`stac_sufficiency()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/stac_sufficiency.md)
  checks a STAC item carries the needed fields;
  [`verify_vrt()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/verify_vrt.md)
  round-trips the result through `gdal mdim info`.

The `gdal_run()`-backed paths
([`verify_vrt()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/verify_vrt.md),
`template = TRUE` recipe generation, the metadata grafts) need **GDAL
\>= 3.11.3**; the pure-XML builders work with any GDAL. See
[`vignette("vrtstack")`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/articles/vrtstack.md)
for a walk through all three.

## Key Features

### Regular Axes

When values are evenly spaced, the VRT uses compact
`<RegularlySpacedValues>`:

``` r

# Just specify start + increment, not every value
gdal_mdim_stack(
  files = monthly_files,
  dim_name = "month",
  dim_start = 1,
  dim_increment = 1,
  output = "monthly.vrt"
)
```

Even with explicit values, regular spacing is auto-detected:

``` r

gdal_mdim_stack(
  files = files,
  dim_name = "depth",
  dim_values = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20),  # Regular! 
  output = "depth.vrt"
)
#> Detected regular spacing: start=0, increment=5
```

The VRT stores `<RegularlySpacedValues start="0" increment="5"/>`
instead of `<InlineValues>0 5 10 15 20</InlineValues>`.

### Extract Dates from Filenames

``` r

gdal_mdim_stack(
  files = list.files(pattern = "temp_\\d{8}\\.tif$"),
  dim_name = "time",
  dim_values = "(\\d{8})",          # Regex with capture group
  parse_format = "%Y%m%d",           # strptime format
  dim_type = "TEMPORAL",
  time_origin = "1970-01-01",
  time_unit = "days",
  output = "timeseries.vrt"
)
```

### Cloud-Native Sources

HTTP/HTTPS URLs are automatically wrapped in `/vsicurl/`:

``` r

gdal_mdim_stack(
  files = paste0(
    "https://storage.googleapis.com/solus100pub/claytotal_",
    c(0, 5, 15), "_cm_p.tif"
  ),
  dim_name = "depth",
  dim_values = c(0, 5, 15),
  output = "cloud_soil.vrt"
)
```

### Convenience Wrappers

``` r

# Time series
vrt_time_stack(files, output = "timeseries.vrt")

# Depth/level profiles
vrt_depth_stack(files, values = c(0, 30, 100), unit = "cm", output = "soil.vrt")

# Regular spacing
vrt_regular_stack(files, dim_name = "band", start = 1, increment = 1, output = "bands.vrt")
```

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("hypertidy/vrtstack")
```

Requires **gdalraster** (or **vapour** as fallback) for reading raster
metadata.

## Relation to Other Tools

### gdal mdim mosaic

`gdal mdim mosaic` spatially mosaics existing multidimensional arrays.
**vrtstack** does something different: it *stacks* 2D rasters along a
*new* dimension. Think of it as the missing `gdal mdim stack`.

### VirtualiZarr / kerchunk

Similar concept - creating virtual references to chunked data - but for
Zarr ecosystems. **vrtstack** creates GDAL VRTs, which integrate with
the broader GDAL toolchain and any GDAL-based reader.

### xgdal

[scottyhq/xgdal](https://github.com/scottyhq/xgdal) is a Python xarray
backend using GDAL’s multidim API. It can *read* these VRTs and also
generate them from existing xarray Datasets. **vrtstack** generates VRTs
from R, directly from file lists.

### hypertidy ecosystem

Part of the [hypertidy](https://github.com/hypertidy) philosophy: thin,
composable tools that work directly with GDAL. See also: - **vapour** /
**gdalraster** - GDAL bindings for R - **grout** - grid tiling specs -
**vaster** - grid geometry primitives - **gdx** - xarray backend for
GDAL multidim (Python)

# Package index

## Stack 2D rasters along a new dimension

Build a new axis from a collection of 2D rasters (COGs, GeoTIFFs).

- [`gdal_mdim_stack()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/gdal_mdim_stack.md)
  : Create a Multidimensional VRT from 2D Rasters
- [`vrt_time_stack()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/vrt_time_stack.md)
  : Stack Time Series Rasters into Multidimensional VRT
- [`vrt_depth_stack()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/vrt_depth_stack.md)
  : Stack Rasters by Depth/Level into Multidimensional VRT
- [`vrt_regular_stack()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/vrt_regular_stack.md)
  : Stack Rasters with Regular Spacing

## Extend a multidimensional recipe

Flesh a small “first-n” mdim VRT out to a full file set, and repair
metadata that mosaic drops.

- [`vrtstack()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/vrtstack.md)
  : Stack rasters into a multidimensional VRT (two paths, one entry
  point)

- [`mdim_template_extend()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/mdim_template_extend.md)
  : Extend an mdim VRT recipe to a full file set

- [`resolve_concat()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/resolve_concat.md)
  : Resolve concat-axis values (shared by both paths)

- [`graft_coord_units()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/graft_coord_units.md)
  :

  Inject `<Unit>` on coordinate arrays that lost it in
  `gdal mdim mosaic`

- [`graft_group_attrs()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/graft_group_attrs.md)
  : Inject invariant root-group provenance attributes dropped by mosaic

## Emit a VRT from a catalog signature

Build a VRT from a sources table and a grid signature, without opening a
file.

- [`mdim_sources()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/mdim_sources.md)
  : Construct a sources table for a multidimensional VRT

- [`mdim_signature()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/mdim_signature.md)
  : Construct a grid signature for a multidimensional VRT

- [`stac_sufficiency()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/stac_sufficiency.md)
  : Report mdim-VRT metadata sufficiency of a STAC item

- [`emit_mdim_vrt()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/emit_mdim_vrt.md)
  : Emit a multidimensional VRT from a sources table and a signature

- [`verify_vrt()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/vrtstack/reference/verify_vrt.md)
  :

  Verify a multidimensional VRT with `gdal mdim info`
